LanguageData.LP_EnchantingTable.label: enchanting table
LanguageData.LP_EnchantingTable.description: A dark wooden tabletop inlaid with a copper-framed rune disc, holding ring stands, little gem boxes and an open spellbook. Here magic is sealed into rings, bracers, helms, amulets and devices, and staves and elemental charms are made. Recipe speed is based on the average level of Intellectual and Medicine. Can link arcane focus stones and tool cabinets.
LanguageData.LP_ScribeDesk.label: scroll desk
LanguageData.LP_ScribeDesk.description: A sloped writing desk covered with ink bottles, quills, rolled parchment and wax seals, with a small oil lamp lit beside it. Spell scrolls are copied and manuals written here; it's scholars' work, counting as "research" and using Intellectual. Researchers can also identify unidentified items here, 50% faster than at the research bench. Can link arcane focus stones and tool cabinets.
LanguageData.LP_RuneAnvil.label: rune anvil
LanguageData.LP_RuneAnvil.description: A dwarven-style stone hearth with a black iron anvil covered in runes, hammers and tongs hanging beside it. Subduing weapons and runic prosthetics are forged here. Burns wood or chemfuel, consumed only while working (about 40 per day). Can link rune quenching troughs and tool cabinets.
LanguageData.LP_Alembic.label: distillery
LanguageData.LP_Alembic.description: A glass retort over a small stove. Placed next to the alchemy table: alchemy speed +15% (at most one per alchemy table).
LanguageData.LP_ArcaneFocusStone.label: arcane focus stone
LanguageData.LP_ArcaneFocusStone.description: A cluster of amethyst on a stone base, giving off a faint glow. Placed next to the enchanting table or scroll desk: work speed +15% (at most one per workbench).
LanguageData.LP_RuneQuenchTrough.label: rune quenching trough
LanguageData.LP_RuneQuenchTrough.description: A stone trough full of blue-glowing quench water, its walls carved with cooling runes. Placed next to the rune anvil: forging speed +10% (at most one per anvil).
LanguageData.LP_DeityStatue.label: patron deity statue
LanguageData.LP_DeityStatue.description: A hooded stone statue holding a holy symbol in both hands; you can't tell which god it is: it keeps vigil for whoever is the colony's patron deity. Placed next to an altar: altar work speed +10%, recreation from praying at that altar +20% (at most one per altar).
